name: Magic Effects
description: Visible supernatural phenomena for settings that allow magic. Entries describe shapes and material effects without requiring a new character or action.
entries: a suspended ribbon of liquid curving through the air
a circular portal with a wavering inner surface
a shattered object reassembling with gaps between its pieces
threads of light connecting engraved symbols
a miniature storm contained inside a glass sphere
a shadow moving independently of its source
vines unfurling from cracks in bare stone
crystalline growth spreading over a metal surface
a reflection showing a different season
a translucent duplicate hovering beside an object
a hovering staircase made of separate stone slabs
an ink drawing lifting away from its page
swirling arcane runes
glowing aura
sparkling energy trails
translucent geometric barrier with visible edges
small stones suspended above a circular mark
rippling distortion around an enchanted object
frost patterns spreading across a touched surface
floating glyphs arranged in a ring around an object
